economic_hypothesis.statement: When BTC and ETH co-move (rolling correlation gate), temporary divergences of the beta-adjusted log-price spread between the two majors represent relative mispricing and revert toward the rolling mean; the strategy monetizes the relative displacement market-neutrally, holding no directional view on either asset.
economic_hypothesis.is_not: directional momentum/trend under another name; single-asset view; funding carry
economic_hypothesis.mechanism: spread = log(P_BTC) - beta * log(P_ETH); beta and spread mean/std from trailing window; enter when |z| >= 2.5 against recent spread trend; exit at z <= 0.5 toward the mean; hard stop at |z| >= 4.0; time stop at 48 bars

assets.direction_rule: z >= +2.5: SHORT A / LONG B; z <= -2.5: LONG A / SHORT B (both legs always opposite)

data.source: binanceusdm public REST /fapi/v1/klines 1h (identical provider authority as H1)
data.fingerprint_rule: sha256 over raw cached rows manifest recorded at execution; no synthetic rows

synchronization.alignment: 1h bars joined on identical openTime (provider-aligned); bar t usable only if BOTH legs present at t
synchronization.missing_leg_policy: if one leg unavailable at t: NO_SIGNAL (never forward-fill, never use a later candle to fill an earlier missing asset)
synchronization.staleness_bound: max 1 missing bar tolerated in the feature window, else NO_SIGNAL
synchronization.gap_handling: gap > 1 bar invalidates the trailing feature window until rebuilt

hedge_ratio.method: OLS of d(ln close_BTC) on d(ln close_ETH) over trailing window (beta of returns, level-invariant)
hedge_ratio.update: rolling, recomputed every bar from trailing observations only

features.normalization: z_t = (s_t - mean_t) / std_t; mean/std over the same trailing 336-bar window as beta
features.correlation_gate: rolling Pearson corr of ln-returns over 336 bars must be >= 0.60 at decision time, else NO_SIGNAL
features.regime_applicability: all regimes (gate is the correlation itself); regime attribution recorded per trade for reporting

direction_rules.entry_short_spread: z_t >= +2.5 AND corr_gate AND flat: SHORT leg A (BTC), LONG leg B (ETH)
direction_rules.entry_long_spread: z_t <= -2.5 AND corr_gate AND flat: LONG leg A (BTC), SHORT leg B (ETH)
direction_rules.exit: z crosses back through |z| <= 0.5 toward the mean
direction_rules.sizing: notional_B = |beta_t| * notional_A (beta-weighted, no leverage above 1x gross)

entry_rule: next bar open after decision (bar t+1), both legs simultaneously at open[t+1] (entry instant identical for both legs; no leg-level lookahead)
exit_rule: first bar whose close satisfies exit/stop conditions, executed at that bar's close; if exit and stop coincide in one bar, the stop is assumed first (pessimistic, same convention as H1)
stop_invalidation: hard stop |z| >= 4.0 (spread dislocation invalidates reversion premise)

pit_semantics.rule: beta_t, mean_t, std_t, corr_t, z_t use ONLY observations with close_time <= decision_time; entry uses next bar open (the fill instant)
pit_semantics.future_mutation_invariant: modifying future prices must leave past beta, spread, z, signals and trades byte-identical; regression test required at execution

cost_model.accounting: both legs charged on entry AND exit (4 executions per round trip): entry leg A + entry leg B + exit leg A + exit leg B; total cost per trade in R = sum over legs of (bps/10000)/risk_unit_leg
cost_model.fees: included in the 5 bps/side (binanceusdm taker reference, matching frozen H1 cost basis)
cost_model.funding: N/A — spot-perp basis not part of the mechanism; declared N/A ex ante
cost_model.minimum_edge_preregistered: a single 1.0 R-equivalent spread move must exceed total two-leg round-trip cost at the preregistered sizing (cost hurdle check reported, not tuned)

DISCOVERY_PASS_requires_ALL.orthogonality: NOT redundant (trade-time overlap <= 0.6 OR daily PnL correlation <= 0.7)
DISCOVERY_PASS_requires_ALL.market_neutrality_structural: beta-weighted gross exposure reported; net directional beta exposure |net_beta_exposure| <= 0.10 average

robustness_gates.slippage_sensitivity: net expectancy recomputed at 2.5/5/10 bps per leg using ABSOLUTE cost semantics (DEF-RESEARCH-COST-001 repair)

measurables: trade-time overlap vs legacy ROC(24) proxy (deterministic replay)
daily PnL correlation on common days
orthogonality_gates.redundant_candidate_rule: trade-time overlap > 0.6 AND daily PnL correlation > 0.7 -> REDUNDANT_CANDIDATE even if raw PF attractive

execution_protocol.exactly_once: single economic execution; deterministic replay flagged technical only; exactly-once marker written before results
execution_protocol.ordering_rule: H3 execution commit MUST be strictly later than this preregistration commit
execution_protocol.no_peeking: no performance statistic may be computed or observed before the economic execution; selection was performance-blind

promotion_boundary: DISCOVERY_PASS -> PREPARE_H3_CONFIRMATION_PROTOCOL only (no PAPER, no confirmation shortcut); DISCOVERY_FAIL -> FAILED_RESEARCH_MEMORY #11; INSUFFICIENT_* -> allowed re-entry with deeper data
